Encantada con el servicio, trato y lugar… 
Nelly es una excelente persona, amable, respetuosa y cariñosa.   
El servicio de Nelly es excepcional!!  Se la recomiendo 100%

reviews.author: Adriana G…
reviews.body:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I got Builder Gel on my natural nails, which are short and never seem to grow, and it was exactly what I had been looking for. Nelly was very gentle and detail-oriented, and I didn’t feel any pain at all during the service. The conversation, music, and overall atmosphere made the experience even better.

I also got a pedicure, and the massage was amazing. My nails and feet look completely renewed. I’m already excited to come back and see how the Builder Gel helps my natural nails grow. I highly recommend Nelly and her services. Thank you for such a wonderful experience!
